paragraphs: KARDA sells an AI-powered police report automation platform that turns body camera footage into court-ready reports. The platform applies natural language processing and machine learning, and it integrates with RMS and CAD systems. The home page states that reports are compatible with popular RMS and that the service is FBI CJIS compliant with end-to-end encryption.

The about page addresses law enforcement agencies, saying they streamline report workflows and free up officer time. A stated goal is that no officer spends more than one hour on documentation per day instead of 4 hours.
KARDA also offers a kiosk report generator for non-emergency crime reporting. The home page invites a free trial of an AI document creator with no billing required.

quote.text: KARDA's goal is to give time back to police to allow for community engagement and/or allow them to go home while food is still hot.
